experiment_data.hypothesis: At r=0.3 (30% real data), spectral metrics will show attenuated but detectable collapse compared to r=0.5 (exp_004, monotonic log_det rise), helping establish the r_crit phase boundary shape. If log_det peaks then declines within 10 generations, r=0.3 is below r_crit and SLV-based collapse detection is viable at this ratio; if log_det rises monotonically like r=0.5, then r_crit < 0.3.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/spectral_collapse_ews && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python run_phase1.py --condition fixed_mix --seed 42 --generations 10 --signal log_det --tau 0.002 --k 0 --signal_mode per_gen --real_ratio 0.3 --gpu 0"
spec.description: Phase 1: Fixed mix r=0.3 ablation (30% real + 70% synthetic), seed 42, 10 generations
spec.data_count: 50K real pool, total_per_gen=50K (15K real + 35K synthetic per gen)
